messages.text: Russell outpaces Antonelli to continue flying start in Azerbaijan

metadata.summary: George Russell completed an impressive practice double as he outpaced title-leading team-mate Kimi Antonelli in a dominant start to the Azerbaijan Grand Prix weekend.
metadata.content: Azerbaijan GP: George Russell fastest in second practice ahead of Kimi Antonelli in dominant start in Baku | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Azerbaijan GP: George Russell fastest in second practice ahead of Kimi Antonelli in dominant start in Baku Mercedes make a commanding start to the Azerbaijan weekend, with George Russell in early flying form; Red Bull's Max Verstappen only driver within one second of Mercedes' pace; watch final practice in Baku on Friday at 9.30am, with Qualifying at 1pm, live on Sky Sports F1 Thursday 24 September 2026 15:15, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights from Thursday's practice sessions at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix. George Russell completed an impressive practice double as he outpaced title-leading team-mate Kimi Antonelli in a dominant start to the Azerbaijan Grand Prix weekend. ​​Mercedes' Russell built on the form that had seen him top the day's earlier first practice session to stay at the head of the timesheet, this time finishing with a half-second advantage around the challenging streets of Baku. Antonelli, who leads Russell by 81 points in the chase for 2026's Drivers' Championship, experienced a compromised Thursday owing to the hydraulic leak that stopped his car midway through the opening session. Harry Kane: Goals, goals, goals Harry Kane set the record to become the fastest player to 100 goals in the history of the Bundesliga earlier this month. metadata.content: Are main stadiums the right place for women's football? | Football News | Sky Sports What is next for WSL stadiums? Skip to main content Skip to main content Where WSL teams play their football continues to be a hot topic and every club approaches things differently. This usually includes a groundsharing element - either with their men's team, with an EFL team or another sport entirely. For many, this includes both. But each season, we see incremental shifts in where women's teams play.
